title: Monotonicity with bounded mean curvature (Simon 4.3.17): densities exist and are upper semicontinuous
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) represented by R = (M, θ, ξ) (IMRep U n), and suppose the varifold V = v(M, θ) has locally bounded generalized mean curvature in U (IMRep.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature: there is H, a.e. strongly measurable for μ := μ_R, with ‖H‖ essentially bounded on every compact K ⊆ U, such that ∫_M θ div_M X dHⁿ = −∫ X·H dμ for every C¹ vector field X with compact support in U, div_M X(y) = trace(p_{T_yM}∘DX(y))). Then there is Θ : ℝ^P → ℝ such that HasMassDensity T x (Θ x) for every x ∈ U (Θ(x) ≥ 0 and M_{B_ρ(x)}(T)/(ω_nρⁿ) → Θ(x) as ρ ↓ 0, ω_n = unitBallVolume n) and Θ is upper semicontinuous on U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → 0 < n → R.Represents T → R.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature → ∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ U, HasMassDensity T x (Θ x)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U
